column1: # Tasks that cannot build on an arch for a reason no base image states.
# Expected platforms are derived from the inputs wherever the inputs say so
# (delivery/RULES.md 14a): build.sh reads every FROM in the task environment and
# asks the registry what it publishes, which covers every task whose base is
# arch-pinned or arch-limited. These two are not that — their base is multi-arch
# and the build then fetches something that exists only for x86_64, so there is
# nothing to derive from and the claim has to be stated:
#   multilingual-video-dubbing: torch==2.6.0+cpu — the +cpu wheel index has no
#     arm64 build, so pip finds no candidate.
#   python-scala-translation: downloads cs-x86_64-pc-linux, a coursier release
# Drop a row when upstream stops fetching an arch-specific artifact.
